notes.title: Patch Notes for July 2, 2024
notes.content:
Finally, the patch you've been waiting for...

Mouse Sensitivity is fixed! Meaning, when playing the game with Mouse + Keyboard, you can now move the camera WAY faster than before. 

NOTES:

[olist]
[*] The camera's movement speed will feel different depending on if you toggle the Look Speed Option while using Keyboard + Mouse or Gamepad. Meaning, "5" while using Gamepad will be a lot slower than "5" while using Mouse + Keyboard. 
[*] Make sure to update the Look Speed setting while playing with the device you want affected. (The settings get applied when you leave the pause menu.)
[*] When playing with Mouse + Keyboard you'll probably want the "Look Acceleration" setting at 9 or 10.
[*] Look acceleration is how quickly the camera speed goes from 0 to the Look Speed setting. Higher acceleration makes camera movement very snappy and responsive. This setting is mostly useful for playing with Gamepad. 
[/olist]

Huge thank you to those who brought this to my attention in the Discussion thread. Sorry it took me so long to figure this out. (I'm one guy working on the game.) 

As always, thanks a bunch for the amazing support! Happy Farming!

notes.title: Patch Notes for May 15, 2024 (Build 1.4)
notes.content:
Hey all! Here's Build 1.4! (The "SUPER PERFORMANCE BOOST" build!)

This update increases the game's performance across the board by drastically reducing CPU Draw Calls and using some new optimization techniques.

The game will now run at a constant 90 FPS on Steam Deck OLED! (99.9% of the time.)

I also fixed a few "fringe case" bugs that I stumbled into while updating/testing this new version. 

Now that the game runs silky-smooth this might be the last update for a while, unless someone reports a new bug. 

As always, thanks a bunch for the amazing support and all the kind words about the game! Happy Farming!

notes.title: Steam Deck Bug & Build 1.4 In Development
notes.content:
Hey again! 

I wanted to let everyone know that another performance patch for "A Night On The Farm" is in the works! This patch (Version 1.4) will greatly improve the game's frame rate and overall CPU performance.

Bug Report:

While building and testing 1.4, I discovered a bug that only affects the Steam Deck (or possibly any mobile PC device) version of the game.

If you're playing the game on PC and toggle off the "Full Screen" Option, when starting the game on Steam Deck after syncing to the cloud, the Steam Deck's screen will be black when you reach the Main Menu. (You'll hear music, but won't see visuals.) To fix this, you have to go back to your PC version, toggle Full Screen "On", and then resume playing on Steam Deck after a cloud sync. 

Sorry for the inconvenience! This bug will of course be fixed in 1.4. 

As always, thank you for the continued support! 


Happy Farming!

-- Matt

notes.title: Hot Fix!
notes.content:
Rolled out a Hot Fix for an Achievement bug! 

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made the "Researcher" Achievement not trigger properly! 
[/list]

Sorry for the inconvenience on this one!

The "Researcher" Achievement is earned from reading all the computer entries in the game. (You just have to click/open them.) There are 20 in total. 

If you have a save file towards the end of the game, you can access every computer in that area, and trigger the Achievement, as long as you've read all 20 computer entries.

Some insight...

Reading the computer entries IS tracked. The information is stored in the game's Save Data as long as you back out of the in-game computer before quitting the game. This way you don't have to read all the in-game computer entries in one playthrough in order to get the Achievement (makes sense, right?!). Therefore, if you're sure you've already read all the entries, the Achievement will ping from whichever computer entry you read next! So if it doesn't ping for you, click on all the computer entries and you're sure to get the Achievement!

notes.title: Getting Started / Useful Tips
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

I wanted to provide some useful tips for the beginning of the game, in case you're feeling lost. 

[b]Stop reading if you don't want ANY spoilers. [/b]

[olist]
[*] The first place you'll want visit is the garage.
[*] Head to the back of the garage and grab the note along with the flashlight, which is in the drawer.
[*] Once you have the flashlight you can turn it on/off by (default) pressing "F" on Keyboard / X on Xbox gamepad / Square on PlayStation controller. 
[*] Read the note! The note will tell you where to go next.
[*] When you get inside the house (you'll need a key (read the note!)), be sure to poke around...
[*] Ultimately, if you're ever feeling lost in the game, refer to the Notes or Audio Logs-- they'll always point you in the right direction. 
[/olist]

That's it! [strike]Use the force.[/strike] Use the notes (and listen to the audio logs) and everything should click.

(Maybe someday someone will write a guide for the game!) 

Have fun!
